answer: By the glacier of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, revoked by a single upheld challenge. A dune of per-task receipts records who did what, and the onyx of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
